parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: lsr-id
parameters.explanation: MPLS的LSR ID，用于标识MPLS网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls static-lsp ingress Tu.template: set protocols mpls static-lsp ingress [parameter1] to [parameter2] next-hop [parameter3] push [parameter4]
set protocols mpls static-lsp ingress Tu.command: set protocols mpls static-lsp ingress Tunnel10 to 3.3.3.3 next-hop 2.1.1.2 push 20

set protocols mpls static-lsp egress Tun.template: set protocols mpls static-lsp egress [parameter1] ingress [parameter2] pop [parameter3]
set protocols mpls static-lsp egress Tun.command: set protocols mpls static-lsp egress Tunnel20 ingress GigabitEthernet1/0/0 pop 130

set protocols mpls traffic-engineering s.template: set protocols mpls traffic-engineering static-lsp ingress [parameter1] lsp-id [parameter2]

set protocols mpls traffic-engineering s.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程静态LSP的入口及LSP ID。
